summary: But I agree we need something like CPanel and Installatron for #OER. The networks I am rolling out using @withknown, Matrix, and @wikimedia are very doable if there is a tech lead. @reclaimhosting has this almost down to one push. Known set up takes work.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
But I agree we need something like CPanel and Installatron for #OER.

The networks I am rolling out using @withknown, Matrix, and @wikimedia are very doable if there is a tech lead.

@reclaimhosting has this almost down to one push. Known set up takes work.
